snippet.title: Concrete Burial - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Page: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4810070/CONCRETE_BURIAL/

Equipped only with a weapon that consumes your own blood, explore an ancient brutalist catacomb. Beware the Eyes of The Whispering Crypt. Find the 4 artifacts of desire. Confront God.
